addr: Millennium Avenue, Nataraja Layout, JP Nagar 7th Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t:
Very big hall, cozy place, apt for large audience over 1000 people..
Accoustics needs to improve a lot.. Because of the big hall size, lot of echo.. Wasn't able to hear speech clearly..
Food was good..
Very nice convention centre.  Separate Function hall and dining hall available.  Huge car parking area available.
Beautiful hall, ample space for 100+ cars, big dining hall. Very good temple outside hall near parking. Huge fan in dining hall, ample space for big events.
